direct_visual_inspection.method: One-at-a-time original-resolution review of every current canonical Firefox PNG; automated matrices remain separate from visual judgment.
review_findings: All eight diagonal window-thread compositions retain distinct spatial and reading grammars rather than palette-only variation.
The 520 px Chat measure preserves readable prose and visible metadata while artifact and pinned-history regions yield outside the Chat measure.
All eight question grammars and all eight work grammars were inspected and remain resolved concept compositions rather than unfinished exploratory layouts.
The corrected Timefield narrow label and retained-focus/compositor capture issues are absent from the frozen final set.
No remaining clipping, low-contrast text, popup collision, or unintended unsettled motion state was found.
No concept is designated or implied as the winner.

chromium_visual_boundary.automation_status: The complete 33-check Blink file lane passed and generated the full frame set.

known_residuals: The 512 baseline, 896 feature-state, and 432 continuous-resize cells are automated state and geometry coverage, not individual human image reviews.
Firefox completed over loopback HTTP; Chromium completed from a file URL. The separate Chromium loopback-HTTP boot probe failed 0/1, so Chromium-over-HTTP is not claimed.
